The head-arm measures were re-run at 76d5d33a3 after the second commit and the fragment was not moved with them, so a reader comparing the fragment against its own evidence is told a revision the artefacts contradict. findings.severity_note: recorded so the section's next pass can decide whether a gated pass with a queued pointer earns a line.
findings.text: a pass whose fleet gate is waiting returns at 'result["action"] = "gated"' before the queued pointers are read, so it appends no verdict row and writes no line even when its lane does have a queued pointer. The plan's Deliverable says the line is appended 'for every pass whose lane has a queued pointer', and the landed behaviour leaves the gate-waiting pass as the one case where a lane with a waiting request records nothing -- the same silent hold the section exists to remove, for the gate's own hold. The Done-when does not name this case, the worker records it in manifest follow_ons, and the plan's own review comment c-s30-never-considered asks for it, so this is a scope question for the section rather than a defect in the landed code.
